params.instr: Compare the observation-to-action chains in this group in 150-220 words. Identify shared mechanisms, differing prerequisites, and missing evidence. Do not treat asserted benefits as measured improvements.

Classify the primary intervention mechanism using exactly one label: FEEDBACK_CONTROL, SIGNAL_INTERPRETATION, RESOURCE_ALLOCATION, STRUCTURAL_CONFIGURATION, MATERIAL_COMPOSITION, PROCESS_SEQUENCE, or OTHER. Prefer FEEDBACK_CONTROL only when observation drives corrective actuation; prefer SIGNAL_INTERPRETATION for diagnosis without correction.

Write an engineering evidence record of 100-160 words: input or observable; intermediate representation; decision rule; resulting action; intended benefit; prerequisite or limitation. Include two short supporting phrases. Distinguish asserted benefits from measured results. Use only the supplied excerpt. Mark unstated fields UNKNOWN; do not invent performance results or claim scope.
Extract the engineered artifact and its stated operation in at most 512 words. Use only the supplied excerpt. Mark unstated fields UNKNOWN; do not invent performance results or claim scope.

params.predicate: An observed signal, extracted feature, measured quantity, or computed resource requirement is explicitly used to determine a diagnostic result, select processing, or change an operating action. Exclude fixed processing sequences without such a decision, permission/token checks, and selection based only on a user's command. Use only the supplied excerpt; missing or unstated evidence means False.
